# Agent Instructions

Use this file as the short, repository-wide entry point. Keep universal constraints here; load task-specific guidance only when relevant.

## Project Context

- `docs/VISION.md` explains purpose and principles.

## Working Agreements

- Inspect relevant code, documentation, and existing conventions before editing.
- Preserve ownership and dependency boundaries; keep changes within the requested scope.
- Distinguish verified facts, assumptions, and unknowns.
- Verify behavior at the boundary where it occurs; report evidence and what remains unverified.
- Do not invent build, test, lint, or release commands; discover them from the repository.
- Do not add instructions, rules, or tooling that duplicate an existing source of truth.
